scope_note: TESTS-axis spine for telegram-llm-bot, mined via the test-surface lens (behaviors mature telegram-llm-bots actually test (test files + test names)) from ['AstrBot', 'ChatGPT-Telegram-Bot', 'LangBot', 'nekro-agent']. Does NOT predict project-specific product direction — that is strategy, not completeness. Non-SCOPE axes are advisory in check.py until they beat the generic-baseline control.

required.what: Basic workflows verify the bot boots, test suites run in CI, and deployments/startup do not regress.
required.day1_tell: a CI smoke test that boots the bot, runs the test suite, and fails if startup exits non-zero

required.what: Edge cases in user-visible text formats such as mentions, emoji, Telegram Markdown, LaTeX, SVG/image links, and markup escaping are verified.
required.day1_tell: a rendering test that sends mentions, emoji, Markdown, LaTeX, SVG/image links, and escaped markup and asserts the exact safe output

required.what: Chat-platform integration behavior is tested across adapters such as Telegram, Discord, DingTalk, KOOK, and mocked platform clients.
required.day1_tell: an adapter contract test that sends the same mocked message through Telegram, Discord, DingTalk, and KOOK adapters and asserts normalized events/responses

required.what: Provider integrations, model service behavior, API keys, embeddings, Anthropic/Gemini/Dify-style clients, and provider configuration are covered.
required.day1_tell: a provider client test that calls mocked OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Dify-style chat and embedding APIs with configured API keys and asserts request/response mapping

required.what: End-to-end or pipeline tests check that incoming messages pass through routing, bot logic, model calls, and outgoing responses correctly.
required.day1_tell: an end-to-end conversation test that injects an incoming message and asserts routing, bot logic, model call, and outgoing reply all occur

required.what: Command handling, conversation commands, CLI init/password flows, and bot/service control APIs are tested.
required.day1_tell: a command handling test that runs init/password/conversation-control commands and asserts the bot/service state changes correctly

required.what: REST/API routes for bots, providers, knowledge, monitoring, pipelines, chat, and authentication are exercised.
required.day1_tell: an API route smoke test that exercises auth plus bots, providers, knowledge, monitoring, pipelines, and chat endpoints and asserts expected status codes

required.what: Database migrations, persistence layers, backup/restore, and stored configuration survive changes.
required.day1_tell: a migration persistence test that upgrades a seeded database, restarts the app, and asserts stored config plus backup/restore still work

required.what: Knowledge-base import, EPUB/docs parsing, embeddings, and content synchronization are tested.
required.day1_tell: a content ingestion test that imports an EPUB/docs fixture, parses content, creates embeddings, syncs it, and asserts searchable knowledge entries

required.what: Plugin fixtures, extension preference storage, MCP/tool integrations, and extension lifecycle behavior are verified.
required.day1_tell: a plugin lifecycle test that installs a fixture plugin, stores preferences, invokes an MCP/tool extension, disables it, and asserts cleanup

required.what: Computer/file-system tools, skill sync, MCP access, and tool permission boundaries are checked.
required.day1_tell: a tool permission test that attempts allowed and forbidden filesystem/computer/MCP tool actions and asserts permission enforcement

required.what: Tests cover dangerous execution paths, API-key handling, passwords, dependency risks, and permission enforcement.
required.day1_tell: a security regression test that verifies dangerous execution paths are blocked and API keys/passwords are never exposed in logs or responses

required.what: Agent execution loops, runner clients, and multi-step agent workflows are verified.
required.day1_tell: an agent runner test that runs a mocked multi-step agent loop and asserts tool calls, intermediate state, and final response are correct

optional.what: Conversation context, checkpoints, token counting, truncation, and history management are verified.
optional.day1_tell: a context management test that builds an over-token conversation history and asserts checkpointing, token counting, truncation, and retained messages are correct

optional.what: Web dashboard behavior such as routing readiness, hash tabs, IME input, font subsets, and preferences is tested.
optional.day1_tell: a frontend smoke test that loads the dashboard, verifies routing/hash tabs/preferences, tests IME input, and checks required font subsets render
